meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把文件夹、网址、粘贴的笔记或你们刚一起做完的步骤,整理成一个「技能」文件放进项目的技能目录(写法遵循项目规范);若同主题技能已存在,则只更新旧文件。只用现有工具按文字说明干活,不引入额外引擎。
howto.when: 当你说“/learn 路径或网址”“learn this”等,或提出“把刚才的流程做成技能”“改进/更新某个技能”时触发。注意:它负责创建或更新技能,不从别处安装现成技能。

say.text: /learn 这个文件夹,把它变成可复用技能
say.note: 会读取目录内容,提炼出可重复的步骤

say.text: 把我们刚才的操作流程存成技能,/learn what we just did
say.note: 它会回顾对话,提炼出可重复的操作步骤

say.text: 把这次踩到的坑补进「wow-on-steam-deck」技能
say.note: 会先读旧技能,就地合并而不是重写

howto.what_en: Turns a folder, URL, pasted notes, or the work just done in chat into a reusable skill file in the project skills directory; if one already covers the topic, it updates that file in place. No special engine - just existing tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “/learn <path>” or “learn this”, etc., or requests to capture a workflow, make a skill from a source, or improve an existing one. Creates or refines only; never installs ready-made skills.

say_en.text: /learn this folder, turn it into a skill
say_en.note: Reads the directory and distills the repeatable steps.

say_en.text: Turn what we just did into a skill: /learn what we just did
say_en.note: Re-reads the chat and pulls out the repeatable procedure.

say_en.text: Fold this new gotcha into the wow-on-steam-deck skill
say_en.note: Reads the old file and merges the learning in place.
